fields.description: A method of a shipping zone as WooCommerce names it, method_id:instance_id, for example flat_rate:3. A bare method_id, such as flat_rate, is for every method of that kind that has no rule of its own.
fields.label: WooCommerce Shipping Method

fields.description: Orders shipped with this method get this Shipping Rule, which works out their shipping charge. Give it the shop's shipping without VAT: the VAT the shop charged is booked beside it, and an order whose total then differs from the shop's is flagged. Leave it empty to charge shipping as WooCommerce did.
fields.label: Shipping Rule
